signature.instructions:
Write one SQLite SELECT statement that answers the question.

Use only tables and columns from the schema. Obey every line in constraints.
Output SQL only, with no prose, no markdown fence and no trailing semicolon.
If the question needs no database access, output nothing at all.

fields.description: shape the answer must take; controls how many columns to select
date windows, KPI formulas and reporting rules already resolved from the documents
empty on the first attempt; on a retry, the previous SQL and why it failed
a single SELECT statement, or empty if no SQL is needed
